news.raw_snippet: For investors, the challenge is less about spotting the AI trend and more about filtering a crowded universe of potential stocks tied to semiconductors, software, large language models, ChatGPT and cloud infrastructure. This is where an AI Stocks screener focused on companies directly tied to the ChatGPT and AI build out can help. **Overview:** Astera Labs designs semiconductor-based connectivity solutions that help move data quickly and reliably inside cloud and AI data centers, combining high speed chips with its COSMOS management software to orchestrate large fleets of hardware. Investors interested in AI infrastructure are watching Astera Labs closely because it sits at the intersection of PCIe 6, CXL and emerging standards like UALink that underpin large AI clusters, and it already has partnerships with companies such as NVIDIA, AMD, Microsoft and Intel. Astera Labs sits at the heart of the AI build out, but its rich valuation and dependence on hyperscalers mean the real story is in the balance of opportunity and risk, revealed in the 2 key rewards and 2 important warning signs.
